corpus_encoding: gzip-compressed PGN, then base64 split across chunk_*.b64
selection: candidate-blind deterministic phase-balanced sample; duplicate target FENs collapse to the latest corpus occurrence

oracle.method: equal fixed-node unrestricted/root-restricted searches for best, historical and candidate moves

competition_clock: historical pre-move clock reconstructed from %clk comments; first move by each colour starts at 120000 ms
notes: The benchmark corpus and Stockfish labels are research artifacts and must not be copied into a competition submission.
This is a static move-choice accuracy gate, not a replacement for real-clock head-to-head Elo testing.
A rival move that is already Stockfish-optimal cannot be strictly outplayed; ties are therefore treated as correct pairwise outcomes inside an 8 cp oracle-noise band.
